0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat, at home, and the Minnesota Timberwolves open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game. Miami has Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Ezra Ausar (undisclosed), Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest), and Pelle Larsson (illness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and has Anthony Edwards, Ayo Dosunmu, LaMelo Ball, and Rudy Gobert listed as day-to-day with rest. The Heat lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance to win.
